scope: Historical research only; no Paper or live orders; no modifications to src/dx27

paper.title: Does overnight return predict the first half-hour return for U.S. market indices?
paper.rules: Page 19 Eq.6: overnight <0 long first half hour, otherwise short; no threshold or stop stated
paper.limitations: SOXL not studied; midquotes differ from our trade bars; table 3 first-half-hour volatility/volume are not known at entry; table A6 drawdown convention unresolved; no direct order-flow causal test

exposure: Retrospective fixed-rule transfer test; partitions are robustness diagnostics, not independently registered prospective holdouts. SOXL outcomes not calculated before this protocol. Prior SPY/QQQ data and results exposed. 2026 SOXL prices are reserved and must not be requested in this study.
data: Alpaca historical consolidated SIP 1Min bars, split adjusted, current-vintage revised trade OHLC, America/New_York and XNYS calendar 4.13.2; no IEX fallback
secondary_source: Yahoo SOXL daily chart and dividend ex-dates only for data quality and ex-dividend robustness, not signal selection
previous_close: Last regular-session minute close immediately before calendar close, including 12:59 on half days; exact preceding exchange session, never last available session across a gap
overnight: 09:30 minute open / previous regular-session last-minute close - 1; split-normalized price gap, not dividend total return
directions: GAP_DOWN_LONG trades only overnight <0; GAP_UP_SHORT trades only overnight >=0; TWO_SIDED reproduces this sign rule; ALWAYS_LONG enters every valid session
primary_entry: 09:32 minute open: 09:30 bar assumed complete at 09:31 plus 60 seconds allowance; still a trade-price proxy, no quote/depth or actual arrival proof
sensitivity_labels: 09:30 is non-executable same-price signal benchmark; 09:31 is optimistic boundary; 09:35 is delay sensitivity; none selected by results
exit: 10:00 minute open, scheduled market exit proxy, not 10:00 bar close; always flat afterwards
stops_targets: None in this first transfer test; do not invent stops, targets or confirmation filters and attribute them to the paper
capital: Initial 100000 USD, allocate 25% of current equity as notional per trade, fractional research units, no external leverage, cash yield zero, no contributions
cost_definition: Adverse price on entry and exit; long factor exit*(1-b)/(entry*(1+b))-1; short factor (entry*(1-b)-exit*(1+b))/entry. No broker commission/tax or short borrow/locate assumed; scenarios, not actual Alpaca costs. Short arms only diagnostic, not operational net profit.
quality_policy: Require every minute 09:30 through 10:00 inclusive plus exact previous-session final minute; missing or invalid bars exclude entire session for every arm and timing; publish all exclusions. Never fill forward. Validate duplicates, OHLC, finite positive prices, nonnegative volume, exact minute timestamps and source hashes.
outputs: overnight vs first-half-hour regression with HAC lag5
trade win rate and average win/loss, profit factor, mean net bps and break-even cost
trade return and strategy excess mean paired calendar-block-bootstrap 95% intervals
compound NAV, CAGR, close-of-trade drawdown and worst trade, intratrade MAE/MFE
fixed gap buckets and previous-session 20-day volatility only as descriptive diagnostics
promotion_policy: No automatic deployment. High win rate must be measured after costs, with confidence limits and loss severity; no win-rate target promised. No parameter search or rescue tuning. A new filtered/confirmed strategy requires a separate protocol and all previously examined data become development data.
